name: 快速 Shell
description: 常驻 POSIX 快速通道：轻量检查与管道优先，支持保序批量、执行状态和输出截断标记。

en.name: Fast Shell
en.description: Resident POSIX shell for lightweight commands and ordered batches.
en.safetyNotes: Executes shell commands in a bundled daemon over stdio. Use trusted commands with explicit scope. A lost response does not trigger replay.

zh-CN.name: 快速 Shell
zh-CN.description: 常驻 POSIX 快速通道：轻量检查与管道优先，支持保序批量。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 通过 stdio 调用自带 daemon 执行命令；命令可能读写文件或调用本机程序。响应丢失时不自动重放。

author: local

agentTools.name: fastsh_run
agentTools.description: Run lightweight POSIX commands in a resident daemon. Use forward slashes and POSIX syntax (ls, cat, grep, find, wc, head, tail, stat, pwd). Use commands[] for up to 20 ordered commands: failures do not short-circuit and results retain input order. The batch has a total deadline and an 8 MiB text output budget. PowerShell and long tasks belong in the appropriate PowerShell or Bash tool. If executionState is unknown, do not retry automatically; fallback=true means the command was not started. Correct invalid cwd rather than repeating it.

command.description: The POSIX command to run, e.g. 'ls -la' or 'cat package.json | head -20'. Use forward-slash paths and POSIX syntax.

commands.description: Ordered batch of up to 20 POSIX commands. Takes precedence over command if non-empty; failures do not short-circuit.

batchTimeoutMs.description: Total time budget for an ordered batch, 1000–90000 ms (default 90000).

cwd.description: Absolute directory, or relative to the resolved workspace root. Defaults to the workspace root.

timeoutMs.description: Per-command timeout in milliseconds (1000–600000, default 60000), subject to host and batch deadlines.
